WITH obs_telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
share_calc AS (
  SELECT otc.observstation, otc.telescope_count,
    CAST(otc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / SUM(otc.telescope_count) OVER () as share
  FROM obs_telescope_counts otc
),
with_avg AS (
  SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () as difference
  FROM share_calc
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, difference
FROM with_avg
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: There are at least 10 distinct observstations with telescopes in the telescopes table; if fewer exist, fewer than 10 rows will be returned
